title: On the intersection of $\mathfrak{F}$-maximal subgroups of a finite group
summary: We investigate the properties of the intersection $\mathrm{Int}_{\mathfrak{F}}(G)$ of all $\mathfrak{F}$-maximal subgroups of a finite group $G$ for a hereditary formation $\mathfrak{F}$ of finite groups. We prove that $\mathrm{Int}_{\mathfrak{F}}(G/\mathrm{Int}_{\mathfrak{F}}(G))\simeq 1$ holds for any finite group $G$ if and only if $\mathfrak{F}$ contains every group $G$ all of whose $\mathfrak{F}$-subgroups are $\mathfrak{F}$-subnormal.
